reason: This is the fourth pitch this year that promises real customers from creators, and the last time I paid a creator I got fake followers and nobody walked in. Mitra's fee being free doesn't help much when it's still my ₹5,000 going to a creator I've never heard of.
objection: My boutique customers mostly shop in English, and I'm not convinced a Kannada creator, or even a self-reported English one, will bring the people who actually buy from me. A promo code only tells me afterwards that I wasted the money.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing results from another Bengaluru boutique like mine, with actual code redemptions and cost per customer, and creators whose audience is Verified rather than self-reported.
